en-US.title: Try eating frozen rice cake slices like this (Super simple recipe😋)
en-US.description:
Hello, this is Seo Ha-yan🤍

This video features me making two dishes using rice cake slices that have been sitting in the freezer🙂

After the Lunar New Year, doesn't everyone have at least one bag of rice cake slices left in the freezer?😂

We usually just leave them sitting around, but today I decided to put them to good use✨

One dish that is perfect as a snack for the kids,

and another that is great as a side dish or even as a snack with drinks!

These are dishes that can be easily made with frozen rice cake slices without any special ingredients,

so if you have any leftover rice cake slices at home, I think it would be great to try making them together 🙂

Thank you for joining us again today 🙏

en-US.description:
Hello, this is Seo Ha-yan🤍

Today, I spent some time reviewing old-fashioned snacks vs. modern snacks with my son, Jun-jae 🙂

When I put the snacks I used to buy with coins in my pocket when I was little,

and the favorite snacks of kids these days side by side,

I realized there is a clearer difference in taste than I thought 😂

I wonder if modern snacks are tastier,

or if old-fashioned snacks really live up to their reputation 👀

Please feel free to watch,

and let me know in the comments which snacks you liked best when you were little 🤍

Thank you for joining me today. See you in the next video, Ha-yan🙋‍♀️
